title: First Epistle of Peter
context: These blocks come from the First Epistle of Peter in the Westcott-Hort Greek New Testament: a Koine Greek letter of exhortation to Christians scattered through Asia Minor, with long participial and relative-clause periods and frequent quotation of and allusion to the Septuagint. Some opening words are printed in capitals in this edition; interpret them by meaning. Keep the structure of long periods visible in literal translations, and divide them naturally in prose without losing any clause. Do not reproduce the wording of a particular English Bible.
